what: When a section gets is-in, text forms like light underwater — the season glyphs (glow) sharpen while glowing over .5s power2.out and the glow settles over 1.2s power1.inOut, and the side line draws .1s later over .9s expo.out. Characters (chars) rise one by one from .45em below, 8px blur, transparent, light-colored, over .9s power3.out (.035s apart for English · .028s otherwise, capped so the total stagger never exceeds 0.9s) then cool to their own color over 1.1s after .35s (per chunk .15 + .2×index s). Text (sweep) has its mask lift from top to bottom after .45s, with 5px blur clearing over 1.3s power2.out (.14s apart), and children of a line (rise) enter after .55s from 18px below over .8s power3.out (.06s apart). When is-in is removed, characters blur upward by .3em in random order (.008s) over .45s power2.in, and text and lines fade out over .4s

options.on: state (default — the element’s is-in) · load (turns on right on mount)
options.dur: Duration of one character rising (sec), default .9
